This Journal is the record of my thought process regarding analysis, approach, execution and management of trades. Successful and failed trades will be logged here for historic purposes and further analysis. Comments are more than welcome. Like with all projects there has to be a purpose and a plan. The purpose is what drives me and the plan is how i intend to get there

The purpose

From a young age i wanted to be free and have freedom of choice, a tall order of understanding for someone of 16yrs old. You learn as you get older as dreams come and go, that they were more of a whim/wish than anything else..........but the fire is still in the belly. Maturity changes things and you can look at things how they are. I do believe there is a place for us all. But i must get to know myself first, by discovering what my purpose is. Trading knowledge is a tool that i will continue to acquire that i can hone my skills to be a more comfortable trader, this will allow me to;

To create more time freedom

To create more choice

To help others and see them grow

To protect what i have

To treat others as i want to be treated

To be fit in mind, body and soul.

Notice i have not spoken about money yet. That’s because for me it is only a tool. It will come and it does already but it is not the primary. It’s just numbers! Targets, well, i will take what the market is prepared to give. I cannot name a % per month or £ per day. Let’s see that the account grows and i can move through the ranks and learn along the way.

The plan

Broker: IBFX

Amount: £5000

Leverage:400-1

Risk: 2% maximum of total account, could include more than one trade, or trades with locked in profit.

Timeframe: w,d,h4,h1. I believe as a trader i need to be flexible and to work across multiple timeframes, it’s a skill that i must master. The clues are hidden in the candles.

RR 2:1 minimum

Stop loss: subjective to timeframe, but must be in line with 2% risk and lot size

Method: mark and review every Sunday supply and demand zones, set alarms. Use boxes drawn to set stop loss and targets. Entry, to use different methods touch, touch..engulf...retest. quasi. Compression.Trendline confluence.

I will share and discuss not only my trading charts and experiences, but others as well and understand we are all working toward a common goal. I will encourage, question and listen. I wish to grow, but be a part of other growth as well.

16yrs این ژورنال ثبت فرایند فکری من دربارهٔ تحلیل، رویکرد، اجرا و مدیریت تریدهاست. تریدهای موفق و ناموفق برای اهداف تاریخی و تحلیل بیشتر اینجا ثبت می‌شوند. نظرات بیشتر از هر چیز خوش‌آمدند. مثل همهٔ پروژه‌ها باید یک هدف و یک برنامه باشد. هدف چیزی است که مرا پیش می‌برد و برنامه این است که چطور قصد دارم به آن برسم

هدف

از جوانی می‌خواستم آزاد باشم و آزادی انتخاب داشته باشم، درخواستی بزرگ برای فهمیدن کسی که 16 سال سن دارد. با بزرگ‌تر شدنت یاد می‌گیری که رویاها می‌آیند و می‌روند، که بیشتر شبیه هوس/آرزو بودند تا هر چیز دیگر… اما آتش هنوز در دل است. بلوغ چیزها را عوض می‌کند و می‌توانی چیزها را آن‌طور که هستند ببینی. باور دارم برای همهٔ ما جایی هست. اما اول باید خودم را بشناسم، با کشف اینکه هدفم چیست. دانش معامله ابزاری است که به‌طور مداوم کسبش می‌کنم تا بتوانم مهارت‌هایم را آن‌قدر صیقل بدهم که معامله‌گر راحت‌تری شوم، این به من اجازه می‌دهد؛

آزادی زمانی بیشتری بسازم

انتخاب بیشتری بسازم

به دیگران کمک کنم و ببینم رشد می‌کنند

از آنچه دارم محافظت کنم

با دیگران آن‌طور رفتار کنم که می‌خواهم با من رفتار شود

از نظر ذهن، بدن و روح سالم و آماده باشم.

توجه کن هنوز دربارهٔ پول حرف نزدم. چون برای من آن فقط یک ابزار است. خواهد آمد و الان هم می‌آید اما اولویت نیست. فقط عدد است! تارگت‌ها، خب، آنچه بازار آماده است بدهد می‌گیرم. نمی‌توانم یک درصد در ماه یا مبلغی در روز نام ببرم. بیایید ببینیم حساب رشد می‌کند و می‌توانم در رنک‌ها پیش بروم و در راه یاد بگیرم.

برنامه

کارگزار: IBFX

مبلغ: £5000

اهرم: 400-1

ریسک: حداکثر 2% از کل حساب، می‌تواند شامل بیش از یک معامله باشد، یا تریدهایی با سود قفل‌شده.

تایم‌چارچوب: هفتگی، روزانه، h4، h1. باور دارم به‌عنوان معامله‌گر باید انعطاف‌پذیر باشم و روی چند تایم‌چارچوب کار کنم، این مهارتی است که باید مسلطش شوم. سرنخ‌ها در کندل‌ها پنهان‌اند.

حداقل RR برابر 2:1

حد ضرر: بسته به تایم‌چارچوب، اما باید در خط با ریسک 2% و حجم موقعیت باشد

روش: هر یکشنبه ناحیه‌های عرضه و تقاضا را علامت‌گذاری و مرور کن، آلارم‌ها را تنظیم کن. از باکس‌های کشیده‌شده برای تنظیم حد ضرر و تارگت استفاده کن. ورود، با روش‌های مختلف تاچ، تاچ… اینگالف… رتست. تقریباً. فشردگی. کانفلوئت خط روند.

فقط چارت‌ها و تجربیات معامله خودم را به اشتراک نمی‌گذارم و بحث نمی‌کنم، بلکه مال دیگران را هم، و می‌فهمم همه‌مان به‌سوی یک هدف مشترک کار می‌کنیم. تشویق می‌کنم، سؤال می‌پرسم و گوش می‌دهم. می‌خواهم رشد کنم، اما بخشی از رشد دیگران هم باشم.

At first this looked good, was falling nicely. But recent demand has rejected price big style.

So what are my thoughts now?

Flip zone and a trendline touch! ok, that use to be my old school way of thinking, but what else is there?

Ok, we have a possible continuation of the trend, on the way up we have seen violent spiking down clearing demand. We look good down to 1.5100, there is small demand zone there.

پس افکارم الان چیست؟

ناحیهٔ برگشت نقش و تاچ خط روند! اوکی، این زمانی روش تفکر قدیمی من بود، ولی چه چیز دیگری هست؟

اوکی، یک ادامهٔ احتمالی روند داریم، در مسیر صعود، جهش‌های خشن به پایین دیده‌ایم که تقاضا را پاک کرده‌اند. تا 1.5100 خوب به نظر می‌رسیم، آنجا یک ناحیهٔ تقاضای کوچک هست.

اما اگر آن هم از دست برود 1.5050 بعدی است که دردسرساز می‌شود، روی h4 نگاه کن، ناحیهٔ برگشت نقش، مقداری عرضهٔ قدیمی که زمانی تقاضا بود.

بیایید ببینیم.

Do not ever tell me pending trades do not yield pips on daily supply and demand.

Many of us work and do not have the time to monitor possible trades, but do not fool yourself into thinking others that can spend all day by their pc will make this work and because you are part time, it is like an uphill struggle.

Listen and listen good, the more time i spend away from the screen the better, i personally didnt learn trading so i could stare at the screen for hours and hours. I wanted to be free and earn some nice money doing it.

Most of my trades are triggered by pending orders, so i am not even there when my good decision pays off and my trade is triggered. When that trade is triggered its not just the entry that is set. The whole trade is, my stop, my take profit/s. Very mechanical!

All i do is highlight once an evening possible zones, and if they are good i set a pending on it. It triggers or it doesn't. it stops me out or it doesn't, i dont really care!

Why do i not care...........................because the math works!

I do not think for one minute that me staring at the screen and using the power of my mind it will make the market go my way! Is that what you do?

I just walk away and let it play out.

وای دوستان، واقعاً فکر نمی‌کردم پستم این‌قدر توجه بگیرد، متقابلاً ممنون.

شما برای دیگران الهام‌بخش هستید. و شما با نیروی این سایت به‌عنوان یک جمع، تأثیر بسیار مثبتی روی زندگی دیگران دارید. یکی از هدیه‌های واقعی زندگی، به اشتراک گذاشتن دانش است یا همان «انتقالش» که می‌گویند.

قبلاً در سطح جوانان بسکتبال مربیگری می‌کردم، سن 8 تا 14 سال. بعضی از چیزهایی که دیدم تا آخر عمر با من می‌ماند، ورزش تأثیر مثبتی روی این جوانان داشت و در طول سال‌ها می‌توانستم ببینم که چطور آن‌ها را به شهروندان جوان خوب شکل می‌دهد. دیدن اولین سبدشان در بازی، تا شنیدن از والدینشان که چقدر فرزندشان با اعتمادبه‌نفس‌تر شده است.

کمک کردن، نشان دادن یا راهنمایی کردن کسی و اینکه او روی آن بسازد و زندگی‌اش را عوض کند، هدیه‌ای است که قابل سنجش نیست.

من واقعاً در میان آدم‌های بزرگی هستم.

I've been struggling quite a bit trying to decide what is the best way for me personally to trade. I sort of convinced myself that I'll learn more from watching the charts on the LTF and that I'll be able to respond to market changes, etc. But what I've found is that I often end up messing with my trades between zones instead of simply letting the market do what it does. Or I will get caught up in the action of the 5/15M candles and not pay attention to the HTF zones that are in play.

Sure, being in front of the screen would allow me to take an LTF entry in an HTF zone, but that's only if I've used my time to really map out the HTF zones, not just watched candles form all day. I saw a post from IF the other day where he said something to the effect of "Watching PA is great but the more important thing is the entire story that price has told to the left of the current moment".

Warren wrote: Do not ever tell me pending trades do not yield pips on daily supply and demand.

Many of us work and do not have the time to monitor possible trades, but do not fool yourself into thinking others that can spend all day by their pc will make this work and because you are part time, it is like an uphill struggle.

Listen and listen good, the more time i spend away from the screen the better, i personally didnt learn trading so i could stare at the screen for hours and hours. I wanted to be free and earn some nice money doing it.

Most of my trades are triggered by pending orders, so i am not even there when my good decision pays off and my trade is triggered. When that trade is triggered its not just the entry that is set. The whole trade is, my stop, my take profit/s. Very mechanical!

All i do is highlight once an evening possible zones, and if they are good i set a pending on it. It triggers or it doesn't. it stops me out or it doesn't, i dont really care!

Why do i not care...........................because the math works!

I do not think for one minute that me staring at the screen and using the power of my mind it will make the market go my way! Is that what you do?

I just walk away and let it play out.

Something else that has plagued me with trading FX is that many of the best moves occur during the early London session, which for my timezone is a real killer to be awake for. I can't tell you how many times I have woken up to find that Yes, that great zone that I had identified was hit and, imagine that, price responded and moved in the anticipated way. I mean, look at those spikes! Who the heck knows where that spike is going to stop. No, pending orders are out of the question, unless you have a huge account or use such a wide stop that your R:R gets out of whack".

I'm now starting to get more comfortable with the zones and am able to trust them more and more. I mean, how many times do I need to see price react to a zone to believe what I am seeing?

So, Thanks for this alternate perspective on what's possible.

There was once a businessman who was sitting by the beach in a small Brazilian village. As he sat, he saw a Brazilian fisherman rowing a small boat towards the shore having caught quite a few big fish. The businessman was impressed and asked the fisherman, “How long does it take you to catch so many fish?” The fisherman replied, “Oh, just a short while.”

“Then why don’t you stay longer at sea and catch even more?” The businessman was astonished.

“This is enough to feed my whole family,” the fisherman said.

The businessman then asked, “So, what do you do for the rest of the day?” The fisherman replied, “Well, I usually wake up early in the morning, go out to sea and catch a few fish, then go back and play with my kids. In the afternoon, I take a nap with my wife, and evening comes, I join my buddies in the village for a drink — we play guitar, sing and dance throughout the night.”

The businessman offered a suggestion to the fisherman. “I am a PhD in business management. I could help you to become a more successful person. From now on, you should spend more time at sea and try to catch as many fish as possible. When you have saved enough money, you could buy a bigger boat and catch even more fish. Soon you will be able to afford to buy more boats, set up your own company, your own production plant for canned food and distribution network. By then, you will have moved out of this village and to Sao Paulo, where you can set up HQ to manage your other branches.”

The fisherman continues, “And after that?”

The businessman laughs heartily, “After that, you can live like a king in your own house, and when the time is right, you can go public and float your shares in the Stock Exchange, and you will be rich.”

The fisherman asks, “And after that?”

The businessman says, “After that, you can finally retire, you can move to a house by the fishing village, wake up early in the morning, catch a few fish, then return home to play with kids, have a nice afternoon nap with your wife, and when evening comes, you can join your buddies for a drink, play the guitar, sing and dance throughout the night!”

The fisherman was puzzled, “Isn’t that what I am doing now?”

Just another stage in the journey.......................

After a number of chats with Red, some things began to click. When i looked at the charts i focused and tried to look for poles, looking at the base of the pole where the source is. Then i could see a return to the base of the pole (the source).

I could see this supply and demand on the chart. But i couldnt really trade it. I just didnt see why some zones held and others not.

Now i had been looking at charts for a few years by this point and i trained my eye to pick up the areas of interest first and work from there. The more you do something,your brain becomes accustomed to recognizing to filtering out what it doesn't need, or it feels it doesn't.

Your mind is a sorting machine, you want to retain good information and disregard misinformation, this will take time.

How much time will depend on you, usually the time it takes to rewire your brain occurs as you experience positive and negative effects. But it depends on how you address them.

Accept that you will always have losing trades, it is how many you have and what risk exposure your account has in the market.

That is something i have always thought that needs to take first place. So my account has always had a number of small loses and a number of bigger wins. My account could go a few days with not much positive activity and then a nice trade would come off and blow away the small loss.

You will find that your account growth will always move in surges and lulls. But when you look at it over time it is constantly building. Do not be disheartened at this. And also do not alter from your trading plan in order to get quick fix trades.

After sometime with Red i was using a combination of the old s/r, trendlines and pa. And looking at poles, up to supply or down to demand. My focus was on a return to the source or base of pole. At times this worked well, as we now know it is only part of the story.

From the moment you start trading you begin to find out the type of person you are and where your weaknesses cause you problems. This is vital that you embrace this as you develop.

I can not scalp to save my life, i spent 6 months full time where i had daily swings going and scalped during the day also. My scalping side was really break even. Where my swings were just as the have been for a long time profitable.

Does this mean i cant trade?

NO, of course not, it just means i am more suited or wired for longer tf.

So, if i had learnt and stayed a scalper i would have probably given up by now.

The question that can decide your fate is "What type of trader are you?"

There are a thousand ways to skin this cat, what is your way?

Trading is about self discovery, you learn heaps about the type of person you are and this spills out into other areas of your life. Trading or any other activity in your life is a working part, If it runs badly, it effects other parts.

Think of it like a car, all parts must work in order to have a whole working vehicle. Something important packs up and nothing else can be utilized.

It is a known fact that the average working class person spends more time planning their next holiday than they do planning their financial future.

There is a difference between "The Have and the Have nots". Its all in the mindset,you keep thinking and doing things like a poor person and thats all you will ever be. Or you can think like a rich person does and you can start to do as they do.

Give 5k to a average working class person and they think "what can i spend it on"

Give 5k to a rich person and they will think "What can i invest it on"

This was the biggest hurdle for me, watching my account grow from 3 to 4 to 5 figures and more, it gets harder to keep your hands off it and let it grow. I had a figure in mind where i wanted to get to, which i reevaluated every year. Why?, its what rich people do, they monitor everything.

Where have i come from?

Where am i now?

Where am i going to?

You see when you make it past demo, it opens up another set of issues LIVE account trading and the games it plays on our mind. But once we are successfully building our account, after sometime things can start getting serious.

What goals are you working towards?

are they material or financial, Family or relationship based. Moving home or moving country. How will this money impact your life? How will it change and shape your future.?

All these things need planning.

What are you going to do about tax and paying what is due?

Will you start a ltd company or a trust?, with these surplus funds will you venture into property or start some kind of business? How will you keep the tax you are liable to pay to a minimum?

How will you protect what you have?

Spread the money between different brokers, spread money in different bank accounts.

If you have made excessive amounts and you have broker accounts, property, precious metals,art, businesses.

How much of a percentage will you keep as liquid cash? and will the % value need to change from time to time.

Will your success change the social circles you move in? Will people change their view of you? be it positive or negative, it will happen.

Will you tell everyone openly about your spoils and worth? or keep it quiet and just keep yourself to yourself?

When you have money and it shows, the % of people trying to extract that money from you will grow, as they use legal or illegal methods to acquire it from you. Be assured, they will.

How does this money effect your partner and your children? What happens when you die?

Best make sure these things are in place ahead of time, you will now when they are needed.

I asked myself these questions years ago, they made logical sense at the time. I have be implementing and reviewing ever since.

Do i know where i am going next? Sure i do

Am i prepared for it? Absolutely

Knowing yourself is such a key thing and I've learnt that for me, if I try to scalp/day trade I end up messing about with the order too much, I do far better taking trades on the hourly and above and then just leaving them and treating it as mechanically as possible. The other key is I use tight stops and try to enter as close to the zones as possible so if it does break the zone I'm trading from I'm out straight away. It means plenty of losses, (around 30-40% of my trades are losses) but my winning trades are always far bigger than the losses.

I would sum up my approach as purely statistical. I don't worry about whether any individual trade is a winner or a loser, the only thing I care about is whether I feel the trade I've entered has given me a statstical edge. The key factor for myself in the journey to becoming consistently profitable was getting to grips with the mental approach, not the technical approach (although that's of course hugely important as well). Learning to let my trades run to their targets was the key and the only way I could do that was to detatch myself from the individual trade results and look at the bigger picture, again that's pretty much what you've explained earlier on.

Story of a mis-spent youth

23.00hrs on 19th November an alarm triggered on my mobile phone "Aud/Jpy Daily supply" After some analysis and a nice little engulf, i waited for a retrace for my entry.

Yawnnnnnn, off to bed i went. All set and done!

Nice to see this morning, price had moved away and fallen over night. Not bad, with a 3 or 4 pip drawdown, not quite IF style, but the right route for me.

Now i do not move my stop down, i let it run to TP, price can return to fill more orders and if your stop is now at breakeven then it's good bye!

Quite a bit of chop around this afternoon with News and such like but after seeing sneeky little engulfs lower, then finding supply above only to drop and make new lows.

I have looked at charts and thought i have no clue where this is going. Now, we all use patterns and thanks to the guys here they do look symmetrical and pretty. Sometimes it is hard to see were supply or demand is in the middle of a chop, but they are there.

IF wrote this somewhere........The patterns may not all be the same, but they all have the same rhyme

Ahhhhh, the mis spent youth bit...........

As i approached our property, i could see that the last leg down on Aud/Jpy was on the way to hitting my Take profit. Casually walking inside, Jared (my Son) and Two of his friends were in our Kitchen, i held up my iphone to show them the current trade and explained that it was just about to hit the red line, which is my TP line. One of the Lad's piped up "Is that real, How much is that then" i replied with "does it matter?"

Now these lads, kind of know what i do.

"It is 100 pip travel" i said

"How much, i say, how much you made?"

"If it was £10 per pip"

This is like the point where i can hear the clockwork sound of a teenager's brain!

"That like......... a Grand....innit! (You cant buy this it is priceless)

"Well it could of been 2 pence per pip. But you are not to know that, are you? I explained"

After a long pause " 2 quid" he screeched!. He burst out laughing. But, only him, Jared knows otherwise.

I looked him in the eye and said "the amount is irrelevant, it is the process what is important!" When you have the process down to a "T", then it can be any amount.

To watch the interest drain from anyones face, is something i am sure we all have had to to endure at some point or other.

I was in the mood by that point to start my 30 min discussion, That is what Jared calls it! Anytime i want to make a point of something.

I took great delight, in explaining that, there is nothing like instant gratiication, so if it was a grand.....anything was possible and quick. But we know, our whole culture is filled with people thinking they can have it yesterday!

Society has been conditioned to accept that instant gratification is what we seek and every minute of every day must be exciting and different!

If a challenge or a project requires effort and will not bear fruit for sometime in the future, it is disregarded as a norm.

My wife, would rather try all 500 diets there has ever been and apply them a different way

Vs

Eat less and run round the block once a day.

Guess what, one doesnt work, the other one does! But whatever it is......................EFFORT is required

So, just grind away at the process of trading and it will become second nature, quite boring, but it will work.

A NEW YEAR MESSAGE FOR ALL.

This is the year YOU take control!

Is it the start of a New Year and a NEW you or will it be like all the other years full of empty promises.

You can not even blame others, because you made those promises to yourself. I bet they were the wishy washy kind, with no plan or goals. Just a “ I wish this year could be better” and by the end of January 2013 it was a distant memory.

Now I guess that you being here on this forum you have at least taken some action! But is it enough?

It starts and ends with this word CONTROL

You are either in control or you are controlled, that’s the brutal truth.

Every situation you have experienced and will experience in life is the outcome of someone being in control.

Be it, your Boss, Spouse, Family member, Friend, Bank manager, Creditor, Broker, Traffic Warden, Government official.

You see the truth of the matter is, if you do not plan or you stick your head in the sand regard to anything you need to address, someone else WILL take control of the situation! Eg: Your Boss controls you because you have placed yourself before him to serve under the contract you have signed. You are under his/her safety umbrella. They pay you, give you holiday entitlement, pay into a pension, a safe place to work

You have GIVEN them control over that aspect of your life.

Be it positive or negative.

The more you turn your back and let someone else deal with it, the less control you will feel in your life.

Successful people are aware of this life rule and set out to rid or minimize these controlling factors.

They understand that some forms of control can not be totally unchained, but managed into a happy medium. Other forms of control they rid themselves from. Think back to many different situations this past year, were you in control or just controlled and helpless to stop it?

Did the situation work out in your favour or the other party?

I will tell you, many a journey starts with the wanting of being successful…….mine did!

The more controlling influences there are in your life, the heavier the chains will be that keep you down. Until you can break those chains one at a time, success will be out of reach. For as you break each chain, you will feel lighter and lifted, a most empowering experience. The dreams you once had can start to be realised.

What will this year hold for you?

Will you be at 31st Dec 2014, with a heavy heart?

You may already be on the way or realising your dreams now, if so, why are you still reading this?

The truth has a habit of hitting a raw nerve, we can put a front on “yeah I am OK”

But deep down we know its not true, like a pain in the side that wont go away.

You know life doesn’t have to be this way, you can almost taste the good that is awaiting you…….its that close.

Whatever you want in life you need to fight for it, but not all fight is physical, some is mental. It is not about how many hours you work or how many trades you do in 24hrs.

It is work SMART, not HARD!

So if you make any kind of loose promise tonight, you may want to think who is waiting on the other side of 1st January 2014 to control your life. FROM tomorrow build it into your plan, what do you need to change in order for you to control more aspects of your life.

CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED

Whats it gonna be?

There is no nastiness involved in taking control, but someone has to do it.

Who’s life is it anyway?

See you on the other side.

Your Friend Warren

یا کنترل داری یا کنترل می‌شوی، این حقیقت بی‌رحمانه است.

هر موقعیتی که تجربه کرده‌ای و در زندگی تجربه خواهی کرد، نتیجهٔ این است که کسی کنترل داشته.

چه رئیست، چه همسرت، چه عضوی از خانواده، چه دوست، چه مدیر بانک، چه طلبکار، چه بروکر، چه مأمور ترافیک، چه مقام دولتی.

می‌بینی، حقیقت ماجرا این است که اگر پلان نکنی یا سرت را در برف فرو کنی نسبت به هر چیزی که باید به آن رسیدگی کنی، یک نفر دیگر کنترل موقعیت را به دست می‌گیرد! مثلاً: رئیست تو را کنترل می‌کند چون خودت را زیر او گذاشته‌ای تا بر اساس قراردادی که امضا کرده‌ای خدمت کنی. تو زیر چتر ایمنی او هستی. او به تو حقوق می‌دهد، حق تعطیلات، به بازنشستگی‌ات واریز می‌کند، جای امنی برای کار.

تو کنترل آن جنبه از زندگی‌ات را به آن‌ها داده‌ای.

خواه مثبت باشد خواه منفی.

هر چه بیشتر پشت کنی و بگذاری کس دیگری رسیدگی کند، کنترل کمتری در زندگی‌ات حس می‌کنی.

آدم‌های موفق از این قاعدهٔ زندگی آگاهند و می‌روند این عوامل کنترل‌کننده را حذف یا کمینه کنند.

آن‌ها می‌فهمند بعضی شکل‌های کنترل را نمی‌توان کاملاً آزاد کرد، ولی می‌توان به یک حد وسط شاد مدیریت کرد. از بعضی شکل‌های دیگر کنترل خودشان را رها می‌کنند. به موقعیت‌های مختلف سال گذشته فکر کن، تو کنترل داشتی یا فقط کنترل می‌شدی و بیچاره در توقفش؟

امیدوارم از این انجمن چیزهای زیادی یاد بگیرید؛ برای من که باعث شد به این فکر کنم که چه کسانی در عرصهٔ معامله‌گری نقش دارند. با جدیت دست‌به‌کار شوید و 2015 را به سال موفقیت خودتان تبدیل کنید؛ این را به خودتان بدهکارید.

وقتی ابهام‌ها کم‌کم کنار بروند، معامله‌گری را همان‌طور که هست می‌بینید و می‌فهمید این خودتان بوده‌اید که آن را دشوار می‌کرده‌اید. اگر می‌خواهید واقعاً معامله‌گری را بفهمید، اول باید در آینه نگاه کنید.
